subject: Computing AKDE at different confidence intervals

messages.author: 6ca3bf0af72d3684
messages.subject: Computing AKDE at different confidence intervals
parts:
Dear all, 

I've been working with Primate ranging data, calculating homeranges comparing AKDE, KDE, MCP. 
Is it possible to compute AKDE for different confidence intervals. I have ran the AKDE with the standard 95% confidence interval and I have looked at 50% (core area) confidence intervals for MCP, but have been unable to find information on changing confidence intervals for AKDE. I think the model reverts to 95% confidence intervals even when using level = 0.5 in the akde() function. 

Any advice would be appreciated

Kind regards, 

Lia

messages.author: 7d868ffe3daa8319
messages.subject: Re: [ctmm-user] Computing AKDE at different confidence intervals
parts:
Hi Lia,

You calculate the AKDE as normal, but then add level.UD=0.50 as an argument in the summary() function afterward.

Just to clarify some terminology, though, this is a coverage area, not a confidence interval. There are confidence intervals around the boundary, but the boundary itself is around the smallest area in which there is XX% of the animal's probability. You can change the confidence interval in the summary() function, too, but I don't think that's what you want to do here.

Jesse
